correctness.rationale: Every generalized-pseudostandard closure step strictly increases length, so breadth-first traversal of all four bit/antimorphism choices with outputs truncated above length fifteen is exhaustive for the claimed domain. For every reached word, one engine computes the exact minimum hitting set of factor-position unions and a second engine tests occurrences directly. Both agree on every word. No word through length fourteen needs four positions; exactly the two complementary length-fifteen words do. For each, the displayed four-position attractor succeeds and all 455 triples fail.
